checks.label: One current passes every cell: after 4 h at 10 A every tank has given the same 40 Ah, leaving 60 Ah in each big tank and 40 Ah in the small one
The weak cell holds less and is emptied first: at 10 A the 80 Ah cell is empty after 8 h, while each 100 Ah cell still holds 20 Ah
A string lasts as long as its smallest cell: a 70 Ah cell at 10 A is empty after 7 h, where the average of the six would say 9.5 h and the big cells 10 h
Once the weak cell is empty, the strong cells push it into reverse polarity: at 9 h and 10 h the 80 Ah cell is drawn reversed, at 8 h it is not, and six equal cells never reverse

On charge the weak cell is full first and then goes into heat-making overcharge while the strong cells still take charge: from flat at 10 A, the 80 Ah cell is full at 8 h and gassing at 9 h, when the 100 Ah cells hold 90 Ah and do not gas
Float at 2.23 V a cell, and the charger voltage is the float voltage times the number of cells: 6 × 2.23 = 13.38 V, whatever the odd cell reads
Single cells may sit 0.05 V below to 0.10 V above the float voltage while the total stays right: the band runs from 2.18 to 2.33 V, so 2.38 V and 2.08 V fall outside it and 2.25 V inside
The other five share what is left: with the odd cell at 2.38 V they read 2.20 V each, and with it at 2.08 V (0.15 V below 2.23 V) they read 2.26 V each
Parallel strings share the load inversely to their path resistance: cables of 2 and 6 mΩ give string A 57 A of 100 A, equal cables give 50 A, and 2 and 8 mΩ give 60 A
Two blocks in series: the emfs add to 25.2 V and the resistances to 14 mΩ, so at 100 A the terminals read 25.2 − 1.4 = 23.8 V; taking off one block's 0.7 V gives 24.5 V
Two 12 V 100 Ah blocks hold 2400 Wh either way: 24 V × 100 Ah in series and 12 V × 200 Ah in parallel
Each puzzle accepts only its right answer, and nothing in its picture gives the answer before Check
Fifteen screens: demonstrations and puzzles take turns, three mixed puzzles end it, and no demonstration says more than about 90 words
Every demonstration settles within 4.6 s and ends where its screen says, and every answer's motion settles within 2.5 s
